description: This file defines an interface 'ITokenClaimsService' in the namespace 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces'. The interface declares a single asynchronous method for retrieving a token string based on a username.

classes.name: ITokenClaimsService
classes.description: Interface for a service that provides token claim functionalities, specifically retrieving a token asynchronously for a given username.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that returns a token string for the specified user by username.
